from fastmcp import Server
import json

server = Server("config-server")

@server.resource(uri="data://config")
async def get_config() -> str:
    config = {
        "version": "1.0",
        "debug": False,
        "api_key": "example-key",
        "timeout": 30,
        "max_connections": 10
    }
    return json.dumps(config)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import asyncio
    asyncio.run(server.run())
